what_it_does: This work extends LAMMPS, a widely-used molecular dynamics simulation software, to run efficiently on modern heterogeneous computing systems with multiple types of accelerators from different vendors like NVIDIA and AMD GPUs. The adaptation allows researchers to run atom-scale physics simulations at massive scale on supercomputers without rewriting their molecular dynamics models. Three types of physics calculations are optimized: pairwise interactions between atoms, many-body potentials used in metals, and machine-learning-based force predictions.
